🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 7,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 1,980 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Omar Baker and Tomás Weber and Elena Ortiz will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Marcus Frost and Hana Weber and Malik Kowalski and Oscar Tanaka will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Ibrahim Delgado and Rafael Haddad and Maya Larsen and Oscar Silva will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
⚔ THE HERALD! You're on your own.
🌅 THE HERALD FALLS. The realm exhales. That was the herald. The sky is still getting bigger.
Something pads into the clearing — The Living Wire. It's here.
Something pads into the clearing — The Moderator. It's here.
Something pads into the clearing — The Eulogy. It's here.
Something pads into the clearing — The Reunion. It's here.
🌪️ THE FINALE struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)

"THE HERALD fell — the coalition's work, and the System had a camera on it. THE FINALE came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Big Beast and lived to sit here. They faced The Eulogy and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: armor the village (3 of 4 fighters armored); put weapons in hands (5 of 6 armed); blood your fighters (1 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
